flagged.adjudication: Accepted in full. PR25 governs seating the poor, the elderly and the stranger in a gathering. The drafter's connection conceded the mismatch in its own wording and applied the tag regardless. Third instance of PR25 attracting a status-reversal passage; the practice is now a known attractor and should be checked against the Didascalia instruction every time.

gaps_proposed.reason: Verse 35 — lend expecting nothing back, for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil — is giving sustained toward ungrateful recipients, which is the definition. PR22 had no anchor anywhere in the index before this.

running_tally: Eighteen additions proposed across all books: eight accepted, one in part, nine declined.
